roles.preparer: Whoever assembled the evidence, claims and render spec. For KO-MOS2-SCIENTIFIC-001 and KO-BISULFID-TERMINOLOGY-001 this is the Claude Code agent working in this repository. A preparer can never be recorded as the independent reviewer.
roles.independent_reviewer: A named human with relevant subject competence (chemistry/materials for scientific claims; chemical nomenclature or lexicography for terminology claims) who did not prepare the object, declares conflicts, checks every claim against the cited source passage, and signs.
roles.source_lock_signer: A named human responsible for the source registry, not the preparer, who signs the L1–L6 lock checklist.
roles.owner: Activates claims, authorizes release, approves URL decisions and R11 certifications.

validation_rule: validation_posture 'validated' is honoured only when a review record for the Knowledge Object has status 'signed', reviewer_kind 'human', reviewer != preparer and not an automated agent, independence declared, every claim of the KO reviewed with verdict 'confirmed', and no open finding. Otherwise the authority treats the object as not_validated (fail-closed).

source_lock_checklist.L1: Identity verified: C1–C8 of SOURCE_IDENTITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md pass and source status is 'verified'.
source_lock_checklist.L2: Captured artifact fixed: a capture record holds URL, retrieval date, HTTP 200, media type and sha256 of the retrieved bytes, and every quoted passage/value is present verbatim.
source_lock_checklist.L3: Reproduced: a later independent re-fetch (different date) reproduces every quoted passage or value used by an admitted evidence record.
source_lock_checklist.L4: Version pinned: the edition/record version is identified (ISBN/edition, database record id, CIF id) or, for a continuously edited online entry, the capture sha256 + date is declared the pinned version.
source_lock_checklist.L5: Quotation scope: only short attributed quotations/values are reproduced; no full-text copying.
source_lock_checklist.L6: Human sign-off by the source_lock_signer (not the preparer).

lock_rule: source_lock_status 'locked' is honoured only with a signed lock record for that source in main/data/sources/source_lock_records.json where L1–L6 are all 'pass' and signed_by is a human other than the preparer. evidence_posture 'evidence_locked' is honoured only if every source behind the KO's bound evidence is honoured as locked; otherwise the authority treats it as evidence_sufficient (fail-closed).
status_note: Restrictive only: this policy adds fail-closed checks and grants no authority to anyone. Opening or merging a pull request does not adopt it; owner adoption is a separate decision. While unadopted, the checks still only ever DOWNGRADE postures.
